name: Fallout 3
notes: Buy Fallout 3: Game of the Year Edition on GOG (DRM-free). Install it on any PC, then copy the whole game folder (the one containing Fallout3.exe and Data/) to this device and select it here.
The classic multi-core freeze fix and an in-folder save location are applied automatically before the first launch — no launcher, no manual ini editing.
In combat, the V button opens V.A.T.S. — the touch-friendly way to fight.
